svg.title: External phone provider on Azure Functions: single-region architecture
svg.desc: Microsoft Entra ID sends an encrypted request through Easy Auth to the SendOtp Function. The Function decrypts with a versioned Key Vault certificate reference. Live requests use an outbound managed identity and OAuth client assertion to call the selected phone provider. Evaluation returns before provider work. Application Insights receives Function telemetry, and provider acceptance is separate from recipient delivery.
svg.metadata: Microsoft Azure and Entra architecture icons used for documentation under their permitted-use terms: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/architecture/icons/ and https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/architecture/architecture-icons . Product artwork is embedded unchanged.
svg.text: External phone provider on Azure Functions
Microsoft Entra ID, Easy Auth, encrypted delivery, and OAuth provider access.
Evaluation validates and decrypts, then returns before provider OAuth acquisition and message delivery.
